::: {.intro-copy}
I am a PhD biomedical data scientist with **5+ years in Swiss biotech, pharma and healthtech** and **10+ years across industry and academia**. I take data-science projects from discovery to operational product, connecting scientific evidence with product design, data and cloud infrastructure, regulatory strategy, stakeholder negotiation, customer discovery and user testing.

My work spans target and biomarker discovery, translational multi-omics, clinical data and real-world data. I am based in **Allschwil, Switzerland**, and hold a Swiss C permit.
:::

## Selected experience {.section-heading}

::: {.experience-list}
::: {.experience-card}
### CSEM · Entrepreneur, Idunox Startup Project

**05/2024–07/2026 · Allschwil, Switzerland**

Developed an ML pipeline from raw data to disease risks and explainable markers, achieving 4x sensitivity at matched specificity. Raised CHF 700k and led R&D strategy for a team of five across data and AI workflows, legal and ethics frameworks, governance, providers and supply chain.
:::

::: {.experience-card}
### Idorsia Pharmaceuticals · Data Scientist

**09/2022–04/2024 · Allschwil, Switzerland · Translational Biomarkers, Drug Discovery Biology**

Discovered targets, biomarkers, mechanisms of action and indications in oncology and immunology using omics and real-world data. Built automated Nextflow/nf-core pipelines in GitLab and AWS and served as lead scientist on a CHF 1M+ programme.
:::

::: {.experience-card}
### Biognosys · Data Scientist

**05/2020–08/2022 · Schlieren, Switzerland**

Developed proteomics data products, R algorithms and Shiny applications; designed SQL databases for clinical data under GCP/GxP constraints; and led a CHF 1M+ cross-functional programme spanning science, IT, legal, regulatory, operations and wet-lab teams.
:::

## Research that translates {.section-heading}

My academic work focused on cancer genomics and long non-coding RNA drivers. I developed ExInAtor, contributed one of 13 methods selected by the PCAWG consortium, and co-first-authored research connecting non-coding mutations with cancer cell fitness.

::: {.publication-grid}
::: {.publication-card}
### [Tumour mutations in long noncoding RNAs enhance cell fitness](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-023-39160-7)

*Nature Communications*, 2023 · Co-first author · 25 citations
:::

::: {.publication-card}
### [Analyses of non-coding somatic drivers in 2,658 cancer whole genomes](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-020-1965-x)

*Nature*, 2020 · Developer of one of 13 PCAWG-selected methods · 762 citations
:::
:::

I am interested in biomedical data-science roles and collaborations where rigorous science, robust engineering and product thinking need to work together—particularly in translational medicine, biomarkers, multi-omics, diagnostics and healthtech.
